blocks.text: Gene of interest ko host cells mein pohanchane ke liye khaas molecules istemal hote hain jinhein vectors (ya molecular carrier, yaani molecular sawari) kehte hain. Gene of interest vector ke saath jora jata hai aur vector recombinant DNA (rDNA) ban jata hai. Phir yeh rDNA host cells mein dala jata hai. Sab se zyada bacteria ke plasmids istemal hote hain. Doosre vectors yeh hain:

items: Bacteriophages (bacteria ke viruses), maslan phage lambda aur bacteriophage P1

blocks.alt: Source DNA jis mein do kataai ki jagahon ke darmiyan gene of interest (gulabi) hai, restriction endonuclease se seedhi-darja (stepped) siron wale tukron mein kat'ta hai aur gene of interest alag ho jata hai. Gol vector (plasmid) usi enzyme se kat kar cleaved vector banta hai. Gene of interest cleaved vector mein jata hai aur dono jur kar recombinant DNA ka chhalla bante hain.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Restriction endonuclease, Gene of interest, Vector (Plasmid), Cleaved Vector, Recombinant DNA.

items: Cosmids (aise plasmids jin mein bacteriophage DNA ka aik chhota hissa hota hai jise cos sequence kehte hain)
Bacterial artificial chromosomes – BACs (bacteria ke banawati chromosomes)
Yeast artificial chromosomes – YACs (yeast ke banawati chromosomes)
P1 artificial chromosomes (in mein P1 vectors aur Bacterial Artificial Chromosomes dono ki khoobiyan hoti hain)

blocks.text: Janwaron ke viruses (maslan insaan ke zukaam ka virus) bhi vectors ka kaam karte hain aur gene of interest ko bandar aur insaan ke cells mein le jate hain.
